injuries.comment: The Hawks said on Wednesday (Jul. 15) that Gueye underwent surgery on fractured foot and is to be re-evaluated in 3-4 months, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.
The Hawks said on Monday (Sept. 21) that Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season.
Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.
The Hawks said on Tuesday (Nov. 17) that McCollum will miss at least four weeks, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.
